body:
Closed unmerged. The maintainer reversed the supersession the same day it was drafted (2026-09-04, live chat: 「所以 ADR-0126 不能简单的关掉」「hotcrm 是标准的软件包，客户安装之后能根据业务需求实现具体的定制」「同意」): ADR-0126 is **amended, not superseded** — its three regimes stand at environment scope, its activation ledger stays as tenant-less deployment state, only D3's reserved `organization_id` is withdrawn. The amendment note now travels in PR #14976 (ADR-0131 D6). The unreleased machinery ships in 17.3 with the column dropped (#15024, re-scoped).
